title: Systems for AI
weeklyTopics: Introduction: large-scale ML infrastructure at industry (Philly, TFX, Facebook ML)
Datacenter background: The Datacenter as a Computer, Jupiter datacenter networks
Distributed data frameworks: Spark (RDDs), Flat Datacenter Storage
Deep learning frameworks and runtime execution
Scheduling and resource management in AI clusters
skills: ai cluster scheduling and resource management
workloadNotes: Seminar-style graduate course reading papers on scalable AI/ML systems from top systems/networking/database venues. Grading: paper summary 20%, paper presentation 20%, participation 10%, assignment 10%, project 40%. Explicitly focused on the systems/infrastructure supporting AI, not AI methods themselves.
prerequisitesText: Good programming skills and at least one undergraduate systems-related course (EECS 482 operating systems, EECS 484 databases, EECS 491 distributed systems, or EECS 489 networking).
